title: Put the Speech Away  (把演讲稿收起来)

segments.t: 差五分三点，在前台，阿瑟在汉娜和格雷厄姆面前一边整理领带，一边拼命读着五页纸的演讲稿。先完整听一遍吧。
'Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard...'
Boss, if you talk like a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
Take one deep breath, Arthur, and put all five pages in the drawer.
In the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the gate?!
Say 'Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for hot tea!'
Let the sunlit glass, Tessa's warm bread, and Evelyn's piano do the talking.
You really think simple hospitality is enough?
Hospitality is what this house has done best for over eighty years, Arthur.
Wait, are my reading glasses on my forehead right now?
Safely in your jacket pocket, boss. Tie straight, shoes clean.
Listen, the courtyard gate bell just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!
Deep breath... smile... let us go welcome our guest!
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段温馨的对话。
'Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard...'
「“尊敬的市政代表，八十多年来，这个历史悠久的庭院……”」 阿瑟用一种极其夸张的语气开了个头：这个称呼
Esteemed municipal representative
听起来就像上个世纪的庄严演讲。
Boss, if you talk like a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
「老板，如果你说得像一本税务教科书，那办事员站着都会睡着的。」 用四个词描绘出的滑稽画面：
fall asleep standing up
结合了“睡着”（fall asleep）和“站着”（standing up）。
Take one deep breath, Arthur, and put all five pages in the drawer.
「深呼吸一次，阿瑟，把五页纸全放进抽屉里。」 为了让别人深吸一口气冷静下来，最自然的表达是
Take one deep breath
字面意思就是“做一次深深的呼吸”。
In the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the gate?!
「进抽屉？！那当他们走进大门时我说什么？！」 因为还不知道市政厅会派谁来，阿瑟用了一个单数的中性代词 they：
when they walk through
在英语里，当指代身份不明的人时，这个词非常常见。
Say 'Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for hot tea!'
「说“下午好，欢迎来到九号房间，请坐下喝杯热茶！”」 过了正午直到傍晚，最礼貌的欢迎问候语是
Good afternoon
既温暖又直接。
Let the sunlit glass, Tessa's warm bread, and Evelyn's piano do the talking.
「让充满阳光的玻璃、泰莎热腾腾的面包和伊芙琳的钢琴来替你说话。」 一句充满生活智慧的习语：
do the talking
意思是让事物本身去证明，不需要长篇大论。
You really think simple hospitality is enough?
「你们真的觉得仅仅热情的款待就够了吗？」 在口语中，只要把句尾的语调提高，就能把这句
You really think
变成真正的疑问句，而不需要在前面加上助动词 do。
Hospitality is what this house has done best for over eighty years, Arthur.
「热情款待正是这栋房子八十多年来做得最好的事，阿瑟。」 对于一项几十年前开始并延续至今的传统，英语里用现在完成时
has done best
搭配 for 来表示持续的时间。
Wait, are my reading glasses on my forehead right now?
「等等，我阅读用的老花镜现在在我的额头上吗？」 这是阿瑟经典的迷糊时刻：用来近距离看书的眼镜叫作
reading glasses
因为有两个镜片，所以总是用复数形式。
Safely in your jacket pocket, boss. Tie straight, shoes clean.
「安全地待在你的夹克口袋里呢，老板。领带很直，鞋子很干净。」 在这里，名词的顺序和中文是相反的：
your jacket pocket
jacket 放在 pocket 前面，用来指明是哪个口袋。
Listen, the courtyard gate bell just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!
「听，庭院大门的铃铛响了！三点整！」 这是 sharp 的另一种生动说法，想象手表的指针正好停在代表分钟的小圆点上：
on the dot
意思是“准时准点”。
Deep breath... smile... let us go welcome our guest!
「深呼吸……微笑……我们去迎接客人吧！」 在美式英语口语中，go 或 come 后面通常直接跟动作动词，不需要加 and 或 to：
go welcome our guest
显得轻快又充满热情。让我们从头到尾再听一遍前台这个紧张的时刻吧。
'Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard...'
Boss, if you talk like a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
Take one deep breath, Arthur, and put all five pages in the drawer.
In the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the gate?!
Say 'Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for hot tea!'
Let the sunlit glass, Tessa's warm bread, and Evelyn's piano do the talking.
You really think simple hospitality is enough?
Hospitality is what this house has done best for over eighty years, Arthur.
Wait, are my reading glasses on my forehead right now?
Safely in your jacket pocket, boss. Tie straight, shoes clean.
Listen, the courtyard gate bell just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!
Deep breath... smile... let us go welcome our guest!
僵硬的演讲稿留在了抽屉里，三点整门口的铃声响了，阿瑟带着真诚的微笑走了出去。我们下个场景见！
See you soon!
